dedupe_keys.name: nlyte dcim data centre infrastructure management suite

description: Nlyte DCIM is a commercial data centre infrastructure management suite aimed at organisations running workloads across their own data centres, colocation sites, cloud and edge locations. Nlyte says it brings together asset data, power conditions, environmental information, workflow activity and capacity planning into one operational picture. The product family listed on its site comprises the core Nlyte DCIM platform for inventory, workflows, visualisation and a system of record; Asset Optimizer for lifecycle management of IT assets, space and cooling; Energy Optimizer for power chain capacity planning, risk mitigation and energy optimisation; Nlyte Intelligence for AI-driven insights and forecasting; a placement and optimisation module that places workloads and assets under power, space and cooling constraints; Nlyte Insight for distributed and edge sites; a Copilot for AI-assisted workflows; and device management for certificates and firmware. Coverage: any data centre. Format and access: commercial software, with demonstrations on request. Caveats: proprietary; the page is marketing material and gives no technical details on the models behind forecasting or placement. Simulation uses: capacity planning of data centre power, space and cooling, and a source of operational data for digital twins of data centre dependency on grid and cooling. Related records: Sunbird DCIM, Hyperview and Schneider EcoStruxure IT are comparable products.
